orders.text:
A.O. No.116 of 2012
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr D.S. Patni, Advocate for the appellant. 
 Heard. 
 Admit the appeal. 
 Summon the lower court record. 
 Issue notice to the respondents returnable 
at an early date. 
 List after lower court record is received. 
(Stay Application No.2461 of 2012)
 Heard learned counsel for the appellant. 
 After considering the submission of 
learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed 
that execution of the award dated 23.01.2012 
passed by the Motor Accident Claim 
Tribunal/Additional District Judge/III Fast Track 
Court, Haridwar in M.A.C.P. No.10 of 2008, 
shall remain stayed provided the appellant 
deposits Rs.5,09,600/-within a period of six 
weeks from today. The amount already deposited 
under the statutory provisions shall be adjusted. 
 Registry is directed to remit the entire sum, 
deposited under the statutory provision, to the 
Tribunal concerned within two weeks from 
today. The amount so remitted by this Court as 
well as the amount deposited by the appellant in 
compliance of this order, shall be invested by the 
Tribunal in a fixed deposit so that it could earn 
interest and would be subject to further orders of 
this Court. 
 Stay application stands disposed of. 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 27.03.2012 
Arti

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
IA No. 2463 of 2022
In 
AO No. 116 of 2012
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Advocate, for the 
appellant. 
In this Appeal from Order, the Coordinate 
Bench of this Court, while admitting the Appeal, 
had passed an interim order on 27th March, 2012, 
which is being sought to be extended through IA 
No.2463 of 2022, filed by the appellant on the 
ground that in view of the judgment of the Hon’ble 
Apex Court as reported in (2018) 16 SCC 299, 
Asian Refreshing of Road Agency Pvt. Ltd. Vs. 
C.B.I., the Tribunal is treating that the interim order 
would be deemed to have expired after the expiry of 
six months’ period from the date of the grant of the 
interim order. 
In the instant case, the respondents were 
noticed, but there is an office report only to the 
effect that respondent Nos. 1, 2 and 8 had been 
served with the notices. There is no report with 
regard to the service of notice qua the respondent 
Nos. 3 to 7. 
While extending the interim order to be made 
operational till the next date of listing, the Registry 
is directed to furnish a fresh report of service so far 
it relates to respondent Nos. 3 to 7. 
List this Appeal from Order, as soon as the 
service report is supply by the Registry. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 15.06.2022
Shiv
